description: TSC highlighting, compiler-backed diagnostics and local GSC compilation.
trust: Highlighting works in Restricted Mode. Checking and compilation require a trusted workspace.
path: Installed LiarsoftTool executable. Use a full path if it is not on PATH. Never downloaded automatically.
encoding: Target game encoding used for checking and compiling, not the TSC source encoding (UTF-8).
output: GSC output folder, absolute or relative to the TSC file. Empty writes beside the TSC. Existing GSC may be replaced.
